name: decent-sync
description: Sync and manage Decent espresso machines across locations

scripts.build: npm run build -w protocol && npm run build -w plugin && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/test/tsconfig.json
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w protocol && npm run dev -w server
